tool_config.name: request_callback
tool_config.description: Book a call back at the time the person asked for, instead of taking counts now. Call it once, after you have repeated the day and time to them and they said yes. The reply says whether the time was booked and gives it in words. If accepted is true, confirm that time in plain words, thank them and end the call. If accepted is false, ask them once for another time and call it again; if they will not give one, say a colleague will follow up and end the call.

request_body_schema.description: The day and hour this party asked to be called back.

hour_of_day.description: The hour they asked for on the twenty-four hour clock, a whole number from 0 to 23: nine in the morning is 9, noon is 12, three in the afternoon is 15. Round a time like a quarter past to the hour it starts in.

day_offset.description: Which day: 0 for later today, 1 for tomorrow, 2 for the day after tomorrow. Leave it out if they named only a time, and the next time that hour comes round is booked.
